tools.name: search_businesses
tools.description: Search a directory of real small local businesses in Europe whose details were confirmed by their owners. Use the customer's own words as the query, e.g. 'property management in Alicante' or 'online QA course'. Returns up to five close matches with name, short description, city, an online flag, service languages, a relevance score and the page URL. The directory is small: an empty result means it has no such business, and that is the answer to give. Always check `city` and `online` before calling a match local: a business in another city is not a local match.

city.description: City the customer named (e.g. 'Alicante'). Keeps only businesses located there. Omit it when the customer wants an online service.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get the full public card of one business by its slug (taken from search results or from a laspi.pro/b/{slug} address): description, services, public contacts, city and service languages, as confirmed by the owner. Returns an error when there is no such business.

language.description: Preferred language of the card text (ISO code). The card comes in this language when the owner published one, otherwise in English, otherwise in the owner's own language; `card_language` says which.

tools.name: ask_directory
tools.description: Ask the directory a customer question in natural language when the customer describes a need rather than a search term. Returns cards of the businesses that genuinely answer it, chosen strictly from the directory and never invented, with links to their pages. An empty list means the directory has no business for this need.
